name: Verity Bandring
description: Sight along the beam to the target and lock the cap's line on the weakest plank before the run begins.

name: Beamdrive Thrash
description: Load the hips behind the ram and drive forward with qi following through the arms.

name: Aegis Beamhead
description: Crouch behind the upright beam so its girth covers the body while qi stiffens the hands on the haft.

name: Boughpounce
description: Break the run's rhythm with a short stutter step so a defender's aimed missile arrives a pace late.

name: Facetbough
description: Send a hard pulse of qi down the haft so the blow drives into the grain and splits the centre plank.

name: Gust Ramtail
description: Slide the heels backward when a blow fails, bleeding the ram's recoil into the ground.

name: Ramcapbarrage
description: Gather qi into the cap and drive it through the door's heart, the shock travelling on to jar bar and bolts.

name: Might Swayswing
description: Surge into the opening before it closes, the ram's tail sweeping aside the nearest defender.

name: Wary Endknob
description: Run the palms along the haft to find where the grain carries qi smoothly and where knots resist it.

name: Steadfast Carryhandle
description: Seat the palm heels against the haft and tighten the forearms so a blow to the cap does not twist the grip.

name: Rumbleramcap
description: Push the haft twice in quick succession, the first beat loosening the target and the second following it in.

name: Daybreak Headcap
description: Roll qi from the dantian down the arms and out along the haft until the wood hums faintly in the hands.

name: Mantled Wheelbase
description: Skid the cap's iron edge along an incoming blade and push it wide before the next blow lands.

name: Gustbough
description: Flick a pulse of qi into the haft's tail so the cap whips round and knocks a foe's weapon from his hand.

name: Iron Ramcap
description: Let excess qi bleed into the haft's wood so the grip stays cool and the arms do not lock under strain.

name: Ironbough
description: Reverse the ram and thrust the haft's tail, qi carried along the beam, into a foe who has slipped past the cap.

name: Boughtorment
description: Tune qi to the door's own grain through the haft so the blow splits the plank along its length instead of denting it.

name: Splintering Beamdrive
description: Flood the beam with qi and hold it forward, its force crushing the door's brace while shrugging off arrows.

name: Remnant Ramhorn
description: Study how a gate's iron straps cross the planks and mark where they leave the wood unsupported.

name: Hoarfrost Headcap
description: Press a shoulder to the beam's side and spread the knees wide so the ram does not wander.

name: Logcanter
description: Quicken the carry across the last twenty paces, the crew's qi flowing to the lead bearers.

name: Blaze Swayswing
description: Skip the cap off an iron strap to land on the plank beside it, avoiding a glancing blow.

name: Heavy Pounddown
description: Aim a tight pulse of qi through the cap at the strap's rivets so they shear and the iron peels back.

name: Stifling Shudder
description: Hammer the gate in short fast strokes so its hinges and ties rattle and the defenders' bracing loosens.

name: Murk Endknob
description: Turn a dropped stone or hurled beam aside with the ram's flank as the crew stands beneath the parapet.

name: Boughassault
description: Hold the beam back while the crew's qi gathers, then loose one blow that breaks the cross-bar and splits the straps.

name: Hour Smitedown
description: Keep pushing after the first break so the gate leaf folds inward and the crew advances over it.

name: Mindful Ramcap
description: Check the carriage axles by touch and sound before the push, listening for the dry squeal of a hot hub.

name: Gustram
description: Lean into the push poles with straight arms and long strides, spreading the carriage's weight across the crew.

name: Thorn Wheelbase
description: Kick wedges under the wheels on a slope so the carriage holds still while the ram is drawn.

name: Torrent Hammerin
description: Steer along firm ground by leaning on one pole and easing the other, qi steadying the crew's grip.

name: Restoring Ramhorn
description: Haul the hung ram to the carriage's rear stop, qi from the crew easing the pull.

name: Chime Slingchain
description: Tilt the carriage roof's hide panel at the last moment so a falling stone slides off.

name: Rumblebeam
description: Release the carriage's rolling momentum into the swing so the ram strikes with the force of motion and qi together.

name: Facet Bandring
description: Heave the push poles back against a sally so the carriage rocks defenders off their feet.

name: Equipoise Ramtail
description: Throw the crew's weight aside when a wheel drops into a rut and flood the poles with qi to right the carriage.

name: Scalding Carryhandle
description: Roll the carriage at full speed and let the hung ram take the door's face as the wheels strike home.

name: Tempered Hammerin
description: Lock the wheels, draw the ram to its rear stop and loose one blow that pins the gate leaf against its frame.

name: Intent Headcap
description: Raise the beam from two matched lines of bearers, each pair counting its own lift beside the next.

name: Granite Endknob
description: Take both haft grips at once, one hand to each twin handle, and hold the ram steady against a shoving crowd.

name: Silt Hammerin
description: Roll the feet heel to toe as if over smooth river stones while the carried beam stays level.

name: Vital Beamhead
description: Chant a flowing count the whole line follows, each bearer's step finishing as the next begins.

name: Rumble Pounddown
description: Strike the door with the cap along a clear line, the first blow of a measured pair.

name: Waning Ramtail
description: Scan the door from the carriage line with a hawk's patience until the weakest plank shows its flaw.

name: Rumblelog
description: Follow the first blow with a second from the opposite line, the double impact working the bolt loose.

name: Charter Wheelbase
description: Interlock shoulders with the partner across the beam so one pair's qi covers the other's flank.

name: Bandring Hauberk
description: Dip low and brake the swing when defenders hurl stones, letting the beam's roofed side take the strike.

name: Hastening Shudder
description: Curve the carry like a river's bend around a barricade corner, the beam's head striking as the line straightens.

name: Drubbing Glint Beamdrive
description: Strike with the first line's beam, then the second's, so the paired force bursts the door and scatters its brace.

name: Torrent Swayswing
description: Advance both lines as one behind the ram, qi shared across them to shield the crew from missiles.

name: Fortifying Beamhead
description: Judge the door's height and the ram's arc from the frame's top as a hawk judges its stoop.

name: Mightramcap
description: Drop into a crouch at the run's start and rise in one burst, gathering the carry's momentum.

name: Slingchain Cuirass
description: Spread the arms along the beam like folded wings so qi-hardened sleeves cover the ram's flanks.

name: Transfixing Smitedown
description: Drop the ram from a height onto a barricade with the whole body's weight behind it.

name: Sanguine Beamdrive
description: Swing the ram in a falling arc from above, stepping through as it lands on the lintel.

name: Fastening Beamdrive
description: Hook the haft's iron collar over a bar and wrench down so the bar tears from its brackets.

name: Steadfast Ramcap
description: Wheel away on the rebound and bring the ram round to meet a counter-thrust on its flank.

name: Novaramcap
description: Rise on a gathering breath of qi, then plunge the ram through the door's upper half in one hawk-like fall.

name: Pounddown Thrash
description: Bring the cap down on the lintel so its crack shakes the frame and every plank loosens.

name: Sharp Ramhorn
description: Set a paired beam across the carry and check by eye that both ends sit level in the bearers' hands.

name: Mightbeam
description: Step in counterpoint with the paired bearer so the beam's weight alternates from one shoulder to the other.

name: Adamant Bandring
description: Hold two short rams crossed before the body, their caps covering face and chest together.

name: Granite Swayswing
description: Thrust a short ram from each hand in turn, the second landing on the first's heels.

name: Silt Carryhandle
description: Withdraw the pair in step down a single line, beam ends kept covering the retreat.

name: Ramassault
description: Strike hinge and lock together, one ram to each side, so the door loses both anchors in the same breath.

name: Gyve Smitedown
description: Cross the paired beams against a defender's weapon and press down, pinning it while the crew passes.

name: Hourlog
description: Swing the two rams in mirrored arcs, one striking as the other draws back, so no gap opens for a counter.

name: Facetlog
description: Drive both beams into the door at once with qi braided between them, so the planks burst outward together.

name: Glancing Might Smitedown
description: Enter the breach with both beams swinging wide, sweeping the doorway clear of defenders on either side.

name: Gust Wheelbase
description: Lean into the wind as into a sworn oath and carry the beam forward without checking the stride.

name: Ramhorn Greave
description: Hold the haft with a grip that does not loosen, however the gusts or the foe's blows shake the beam.

name: Rumble Ramtail
description: Release the ram in the lull between gusts, so its blow lands while the wind is still.

name: Chime Endknob
description: Call the bearing to the target by the wind's direction and the lie of the ground ahead.

name: Logassault
description: Run the last paces along an exposed edge with the beam lowered, striking before defenders hear the wind change.

name: Hardened Headcap
description: Angle the beam into a crosswind so its flank takes the gust and spills it past the crew.

name: Nova Shudder
description: Swear the strike aloud, then drive the cap through the bolted door with qi gathered to a single point.

name: Ramsprint
description: Follow the gust through the broken door with the ram held low, striking the first defender in its lee.

name: Ramcap Linctus
description: Take a bearing on the door from a fixed mark and hold it as the crew advances over broken ground.

name: Ramcapleap
description: Walk the taken bearing without drift, the crew's feet following the leader's heel marks.

name: Charter Carryhandle
description: Crouch in the beam's wind shadow so thrown stones lose their line and the crew's qi settles.

name: Logthrash
description: Thrust the ram along the taken bearing so the cap meets the lock exactly where it was aimed.

name: Silt Smitedown
description: Shift the whole crew a pace sideways when a gust pushes the beam, restoring the line before the blow.

name: Vigorous Beamhead
description: Speak the oath count aloud so each bearer drives on the same syllable despite the wind.

name: Scalding Hammerin
description: Heave on the spoken count's last word, qi flowing through every bearer into the beam's head.

name: Steadfast Slingchain
description: Pivot the beam on the held bearing to turn aside a lunging spear, then step back onto the line.

name: Harrowing Shudder
description: Press the ram against the door with the wind at the crew's back until the timber bows inward.

name: Logtorment
description: Strike the door on the exact bearing taken, qi gathered along it, so the blow splits bar and brackets together.

name: Torrent Smitedown
description: Advance the crew in a held line through the breach with the beam sweeping, clearing the way ahead.

name: Renewing Headcap
description: Read loose stone, turf and frost beneath the crew's feet from the tremble of the beam.

name: Gustbeam
description: Settle the beam on the windward shoulder so the gusts press it into place instead of lifting it.

name: Facet Beamhead
description: Stand the beam upright before the crew in the open, qi held in the arms against any spear.

name: Transfixing Shudder
description: Drive the ram into the door in the half-breath after a gust passes, while the foe's ears are dulled.

name: Smitedown Pounce
description: Sprint along the plateau's lip with the ram on the inner arm, never glancing at the drop.

name: Anointing Ramtail
description: Rest the crew in the beam's lee while qi circulates through tired shoulders.

name: Gustramcap
description: Shift bearing in mid-run toward the side defenders do not guard, spoiling their aimed shot.

name: Smitedown Onslaught
description: Match the blow to a rising gust so the door's bolts rattle with both wind and strike.

name: Invigorating Bandring
description: Haul the ram's chain hand over hand while the crew speaks the oath, qi linking the line against any counter.

name: Murk Ramhorn
description: Swing the beam with a gust to meet a charging foe, turning his rush aside.

name: Beamdrive Onslaught
description: Draw a deep breath of qi into the beam as the wind rises, then loose one drive that shatters bar and brace.

name: Swayswing Onslaught
description: Press the line forward behind the beam like a gust over open ground, bowling over every defender at the breach.
